Auth._comment: Mode: Log = tokens are read and used but requests without one are only logged; Enforce = 401 without a valid token; Off = ignore tokens. Set TokenSecret (32+ random chars) or the AuthTokenSecret env var on prod; without it a random key is used and everyone is signed out on each restart.

LinkLogin._comment: Secret used to sign parent magic-link tokens. Set a strong random value on prod (or the LinkLoginSecret env var). Rotating it invalidates all outstanding links.
